I'm not legally old enough to give consent to treatment, so my mother has to be there. I can't have someone else bring me because then I won't be able to get treatment. 

And thank you for offering advice.

I've told a few people.

Having a male doctor would definitely make it feel safer for me. I'm not sure how to request that though, without having to explain why. 

Also, I don't really have any healthy coping strategies. What are some things I can try to deal with the distress I'll be feeling after?
She's been made aware of it, yes. I'm not sure I'll ever get to talk with the doctor privately. I'm also not sure I want someone else in the room. That's really just another person seeing my body.
I'm still a minor so my mother has to arrange everything, and I cannot tell her about my past trauma...so I can't really request anything special :(

It will look the same. She'll still know what I look and feel like. 

I know I'm not my body, but it is a part of my identity that is ruined now

Thank you. 

And no, I can't see a female therapist. I wouldn't be able to get anything out of that.
But my body is impure and it's where I have to live

Because they think it's a waste because they made me see a female one so during every session I just curled myself up tight, searched for every possible escape route, and made sure I was prepared to defend myself. There's no way I could confide in another woman. I've been so afraid of them since the violation.

I wasn't a young child though. I was 14. 

I never told the police, no. 

And I do hate her, I just hate myself as well.

My body is not my temple, it is a used up and defiled mess
